p.description: Array of polynomial coefficients having rank-1.

strip_zeros.description: bool, default=True. If True, then leading zeros in the coefficients will be stripped, similar to :func:`numpy.roots`. If set to False, leading zeros will not be stripped, and undefined roots will be represented by NaN values in the function output. ``strip_zeros`` must be set to ``False`` for the function to be compatible with :func:`jax.jit` and other JAX transformations.
constraints: strip_zeros must be set to False for the function to be compatible with jax.jit and other JAX transformations.
strip_zeros must be one of numpy.roots, False, jax.jit, JAX

output.description: An array containing the roots of the polynomial.

constraints: jnp.roots returns the roots with default behavior matching numpy and stripping leading zeros.
